name: Sorrowful Void
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5
Duration 1 round/level (D), see tex.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as call the void, except in addition to the spell’s normal effect, a creature that takes damage must also roll a Will save or take a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls for 1 minute per caster level.

Once a target has had to roll a Will save against this spell, they are immune to the Will save portion of the spell for the remaining duration. The Will-save portion of the spell is an emotion, mind-affecting effect.
